overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Everything here acts on production data with your administrator rights. Take care.

security.title: Protected session
security.textSuperadmin: Signed in with password and one-time code. The session ends after 15 minutes of inactivity and after 8 hours at most.
security.textSiteAdmin: The session ends after 15 minutes of inactivity and after 8 hours at most. Sign out on shared computers.

errors.title: The deployment API didn’t answer correctly

charts.statusLabel: Bar chart: number of deployments per status among the latest {count}.
charts.activityLabel: Area chart: deployments created per day over the last 14 days.

login.title: Administrator sign-in
login.intro: Restricted area. Sign in with an administrator account: a password and a one-time code from your authenticator app are required.
login.otpHint: First sign-in? Keycloak shows a QR code: scan it with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).

errors.expired: The sign-in attempt expired. Please try again.
errors.failed: We couldn’t complete the sign-in. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: The identity server is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.session_unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts from your network. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.forbidden: This account isn’t an administrator. Sign in with an administrator account.

testAccounts.title: Local test account
testAccounts.alice: administrator: password “password”, one-time code from the dev OTP secret (README)

notFound.title: This page doesn’t exist
notFound.text: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.subtitle: Every deployment, all owners. Search by name or version.

create.title: New deployment
create.description: It starts as “pending”. You are recorded as its owner.
create.name: Name

export.tooMany: Too many exports. Please wait a few minutes.
export.failed: The export failed: the deployment API didn’t answer correctly.

validation.invalidSlug: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (e.g. my-article).
validation.atLeastOneLanguage: Fill in at least one language.
validation.invalidDate: Choose a valid date and time.
validation.tooSoon: Choose a time at least a minute from now.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.subtitle: Every component of @web/ui, in this app’s theme. Import them as @web/ui/<name>; both sites share them.

samples.tabsContent: Tabs switch panels without leaving the page.
samples.dialogText: Dialogs trap focus, close with Escape and restore focus on close.
samples.popoverText: Popovers hold small forms or details.
samples.tooltipText: Tooltips explain icons and short labels.
samples.drawerHint: Mobile section menu: its links scroll smoothly to blocks of this page.
samples.editorOutput: HTML output (sanitize it on the server before displaying it)
samples.sortableHint: Drag the handles, or focus one and use Space and the arrow keys.
samples.motionText: This card faded in when it scrolled into view (motion), unless you prefer reduced motion.

source.hint: Edit the HTML directly. On save the server keeps only the allowed tags, layout classes (tpl-*) and the site's own images (/images/…); anything else is removed.
source.layoutWarning: The visual editor would drop these (the server would not keep them either):

layout.unwrap: Remove the block frame (keep its content)

sortable.instructions: To pick up an item, press Space. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel.

overviewSites.title: Your sites
overviewSites.subtitle: Open a site to manage its articles.
overviewSites.empty: You are not an administrator of any site yet. Ask a superadmin to add you to one.

articles.title: Articles
articles.subtitle: {site}: write, schedule and publish articles in every language of the site.
articles.caption: Articles of {site}
articles.empty: No article yet. Write the first one.

form.languagesHint: A draft may miss languages; publishing needs every language of the site ({locales}).
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: Five habits for nails that last
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Filled from the title until you change it.
form.excerptHint: Shown in lists and in search results.
form.coverAltHint: For people who can’t see the image (the cover itself comes later).

cover.label: Cover image
cover.hint: Shown in article lists, at the top of the article and in link previews. The alt text is set per language.

form.noCategories: This site has no topic yet: create one first.
form.sanitized: Saved. The server removed what isn't allowed: {items}.
form.liveWarning: This article is live: saved changes appear on the site right away.
form.scheduledWarning: This article is scheduled: it goes live with these changes.
form.checkFields: Some fields need your attention (the marked tabs and fields).

translate.hint: Machine-translate from {source} into {target} with AI. The translation is saved as a draft for you to review before publishing.
translate.confirmOverwrite: The current {target} version will be replaced.
translate.done: Translated ({provider}). This is a machine translation: review it before publishing.
translate.draftOnly: Only drafts can be translated: unpublish the article first.
translate.noSource: Write and save the {source} version first.

reasons.provider_unavailable: the AI service is not answering right now, try again later.
reasons.provider_refused: the AI service refused the request.
reasons.invalid_output: the result did not match the original, try again.
reasons.article_not_draft: the article was published while it was being translated.
reasons.translation_exists: the article already has this language.

errors.translation_exists: The article already has this language.
errors.missing_source: The article has no text in the main language yet.
errors.invalid_locale: That language is not one of this site.
errors.too_large: The article is too long to translate in one go.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests, wait a moment.

publish.title: Publish this article
publish.description: Every language of the site must be complete.
publish.atHint: At least a minute from now, your time zone ({tz}).
publish.unpublished: The article is a draft again.
publish.unpublishTitle: Take this article off the site?
publish.unpublishDescription: It becomes a draft again. Its address stops working until it is published again.

delete.title: Delete this article?
delete.description: It is deleted for good, in every language. A live article disappears from the site.

categories.title: Topics
categories.subtitle: {site}: every article belongs to one topic.
categories.keyHint: A short id that never changes, e.g. care.
categories.name: Name ({locale})
categories.caption: Topics of {site}
categories.description: A name and a URL in every language of the site.
categories.deleteDescription: Only a topic no article uses can be deleted.
categories.inUse: Articles still use this topic: move them first.

media.title: Media library
media.subtitle: Images for the articles of {site}: covers and images in the text. Images are optimized in your browser before they are uploaded.
media.optimizeHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF. Converted to WebP in up to 3 sizes (640, 1280, 1920 px), with location and camera data removed.
media.empty: No images yet. Upload the first one above.
media.copyFailed: Could not copy: the browser blocked the clipboard.
media.pickerHint: Click an image to choose it, or upload a new one (optimized automatically).

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unsupported_type: Unsupported format: use JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF.
errors.too_large: The image is too large (40 MB at most before optimization).
errors.decode_failed: This image could not be read (damaged file or unusual format).
errors.encode_failed: The browser could not optimize this image.
errors.upload_failed: The image storage could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.upload_rejected: The image storage refused the file (expired link). Please try again.
errors.upload_incomplete: The image was not fully uploaded. Please try again.
errors.upload_mismatch: The uploaded file differed from the declared one, so it was removed.
errors.media_in_use: An article uses this image (cover or text). Remove it from the article first.
errors.rate_limited: Too many uploads in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network_error: The server could not be reached.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.generation_in_progress: The image is still being generated: delete it once it is ready.

ai.title: Generate with AI
ai.hint: Describe the image you need: AI creates a new one (no text, logos or real people), optimized and saved to the library.
ai.promptPlaceholder: E.g. A bright laundromat, rows of washing machines, flat illustration, green tones
ai.partial: {made}/{count} image(s) generated, some could not be made
ai.watermark: AI images carry Google's invisible SynthID watermark. Review them before publishing.

errors.quota_exceeded: This site has used all its AI images for this month.
errors.provider_refused: The AI refused this description (it may break the content policy). Rewrite it.
errors.provider_unavailable: The AI service is busy or down. Try again later.
errors.invalid_response: The AI returned something unusable. Try again.
errors.not_generated: This image could not be made.
errors.timeout: No answer after a few minutes. The images will appear in the library when ready.
